cache.title: Cache
cache.subtitle: Domains and records held in the resolver cache
cache.description: Inspect and clear locally cached resolutions. Cache entries expire automatically once their TTL runs out.

allowed.title: Allowed list
allowed.subtitle: Domains that are always permitted
allowed.description: Domains here are let through even if they match a block list. Use this to whitelist sites that were blocked by mistake.

blocked.title: Blocked list
blocked.subtitle: Domains that are always blocked
blocked.description: Domains here are answered using the block mode configured on the server. Commonly used for ad and malware blocking.

tree.noRecords: No cached records under this domain

add.title: Add domain
add.domainHelp: Enter a full domain name. Adding a parent domain also covers all of its subdomains.

import.title: Bulk import domains
import.subtitle: One domain per line. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
import.fileDrop: Drop a text file here, or click to select

flush.confirmCache: Flush the entire resolver cache? Query latency will rise briefly afterwards.
flush.confirmAllowed: Flush the allowed list? Every whitelisted domain will be removed.
flush.confirmBlocked: Flush the blocked list? Every blocking rule will be dropped.

blocking.bannerBody: enableBlocking is not turned on in server settings, so the blocked list has no effect.
blocking.temporaryDisableHint: Pause all blocking for a set duration to allow temporary access to a site.

empty.cache: The resolver cache is currently empty
empty.cacheHint: Cache entries will appear here once clients start sending queries.
empty.allowedHint: Add domains that should bypass blocking to prevent false positives.
empty.blockedHint: Add domains manually, or configure block list URLs in settings for automatic sync.
